fullContentHtml:
Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Admit Card - Complete Details

Short Information : Join Indian Navy has released Admit Card for the recruitment of 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 on the official website. Applications for the Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Recruitment were accepted from May 29, 2026, to June 29, 2026. The written examination is going to conducted in September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Admit Card from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 22 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 29 May 2026
  • Last Date : 29 June 2026 (Extended)
  • SSB Exam Date : September 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 September 2026

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Admit Card?

Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry January 2027 Admit Card is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 29 June 2026 (Extended).

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
